edges.reason: msg.sender becomes the 'from' argument of _transfer via transfer/_msgSender.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender for allowance spending.
deliver takes _msgSender() as sender and debits its reflections.
constructor assigns _rOwned[_msgSender()] and derives the initial owner.
_owner is derived from msg.sender and compared in onlyOwner checks.
_transfer invokes swapAndLiquify while still executing transfer logic.
swapAndLiquify calls swapTokensForEth which performs an external call.
swapAndLiquify calls addLiquidity which performs an external payable call.
swapAndLiquify pushes ETH to wallet before finishing state updates.
swapAndLiquify pushes ETH to wallet2 before finishing state updates.
swapTokensForEth triggers the router swap external call.
addLiquidity triggers the router addLiquidityETH external payable call.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline, making execution miner-time dependent.
block.timestamp is passed as the liquidity deadline, making execution miner-time dependent.
The swap call is dispatched on the uniswapRouter state variable.
The addLiquidityETH call is dispatched on the uniswapRouter state variable.
The router swap loops back into the token's transfer hooks re-entering _transfer.
addLiquidityETH pull-transfer re-enters the token transfer logic.
_transfer delegates the actual balance mutation to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer calls _takeLiquidity to credit liquidity tokens.
_transfer variants call _getValues to compute fees and amounts.
_takeLiquidity increases _rOwned[address(this)].
_takeLiquidity multiplies the liquidity amount by the reflection rate.
_getValues multiplies token amounts and fees by the reflection rate.
_transfer mutates _rOwned balances of sender and recipient.
_transfer enforces the _maxTxAmount cap for non-owner transfers.
_transfer reads the limit flag to gate amount and balance caps.
_transfer checks the launched flag to redirect early pair buys to burn address.
_transfer checks swapAndLiquifyEnabled before triggering the swap.
_transfer checks inSwapAndLiquify as a reentrancy guard condition.
_transfer compares the contract balance against minTokensBeforeSwap.
_transfer compares addresses against the uniswapPair to detect buys.
setMaxTxPercent performs multiplication and division to derive the cap.
setMaxTxPercent writes the computed value into _maxTxAmount.
setMaxTxPercent uses _tTotal as the arithmetic base.
transferFrom reads and reduces the _allowances entry.
transferFrom delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve to update the remaining allowance.
transfer delegates token movement to _transfer.
deliver subtracts rAmount from _rOwned of the sender.
deliver reduces the total reflection supply _rTotal.
deliver calls _getValues to obtain the reflection amount.
excludeFromReward flips the _isExcluded flag for the account.
excludeFromReward appends the account to the _excluded array.
excludeFromReward is restricted by the onlyOwner gate reading _owner.
includeInReward removes the account from the _excluded array.
includeInReward is restricted by the onlyOwner gate reading _owner.
moon sets the launched flag, privileged by ownership.
moon enables swapAndLiquify, privileged by ownership.
moon is restricted by the onlyOwner gate reading _owner.
changeLimit permanently disables the transfer limit flag.
changeLimit is restricted by the onlyOwner gate reading _owner.
setMinTokensBeforeSwap sets the swap threshold controlling swap triggering.
setMinTokensBeforeSwap is restricted by the onlyOwner gate reading _owner.
_approve writes the allowance into _allowances.
constructor mints the full reflection supply to _rOwned[msg.sender].
constructor initializes _rTotal from MAX and _tTotal.
constructor assigns the wallet fee recipient.
constructor assigns the wallet2 fee recipient.
constructor stores the Uniswap V2 router interface.
constructor creates and stores the Uniswap pair address.
constructor excludes wallet, wallet2, owner and contract from fees.
constructor initializes _owner with the deployer address.
The lockTheSwap modifier reads inSwapAndLiquify as the reentrancy guard.
lockTheSwap sets inSwapAndLiquify true before and false after the body.
The from parameter is consumed by _transfer validation and branching.
The to parameter is consumed by _transfer validation and branching.
The amount parameter drives all cap checks in _transfer.
from indexes the _rOwned mapping debit.
contractTokenBalance parameter is split inside swapAndLiquify.
tokenAmount parameter is approved and swapped in swapTokensForEth.
Local path array is built and passed to the router in swapTokensForEth.
sender parameter is used for balance debit and allowance lookup.
recipient parameter receives the transferred amount.
amount parameter is subtracted from the allowance.
maxTxPercent parameter is bounded and converted into _maxTxAmount.
amount parameter is written into minTokensBeforeSwap.
account parameter is flagged and pushed into _excluded.
tokenAmount parameter is approved for the liquidity add.
ethAmount parameter becomes the msg.value of addLiquidityETH.
initialBalance local captures address(this).balance before the swap.
The router returns swapped ETH to the contract through receive(), re-entering the payable fallback.

normalization_plan.reason: Source address parameter is only meaningful as part of _transfer's balance mutation and limit checks.
Destination address parameter only carries the receiver identity for _transfer.
Amount parameter is consumed entirely by _transfer's cap and fee checks.
Balance parameter is split and swapped only inside swapAndLiquify.
Token amount is approved and passed to the router only within swapTokensForEth.
Local swap path array exists solely for the router call inside swapTokensForEth.
Sender parameter only drives allowance and balance debit in transferFrom.
Recipient parameter is only used as the transfer target in transferFrom.
Amount parameter is only used for allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
Percentage parameter is bounded and converted into _maxTxAmount inside setMaxTxPercent.
Amount parameter is directly stored into the minTokensBeforeSwap threshold.
Account parameter is only used to flag and record the excluded account.
Token amount is only approved for the router liquidity call.
ETH amount is only used as msg.value for the liquidity call.
Initial balance local is only used to measure ETH gained during the swap.
